content.text:
I added due dates. Each todo stores its due date as a `YYYY-MM-DD` string. Today's date comes from local date parts, so nothing goes through UTC. A todo is overdue only when its date is before today (string comparison), so a todo due today never is. Every row has `data-overdue`, overdue rows turn red, and the page re-renders when the day changes. The checks pass in three time zones.

I rejected `new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')` and `toISOString()` because both read or write the date as UTC. Completed todos can still show as overdue, because your definition doesn't exclude them.
